title: Does Inter-Model Homogeneity Predict Enterprise AI Pilot Failure?

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Correlational survey design establishes association but not causation between portfolio homogeneity and failure. The link is plausible but has a causal gap: many confounders (org size, use case complexity) could explain the same correlation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires recruiting enterprise practitioners, designing a valid survey instrument, and obtaining organizational data. This is social science methodology that CS beginners lack training in. Access to enterprise contacts is a significant barrier.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Survey design, participant recruitment, data collection, and statistical analysis across organizations is an open-ended effort with unclear timelines. Not feasible in 30 hours.

title: Do Human Annotators Perceive Homogeneous Outputs as Diverse?

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong causal chain: if humans cannot detect homogeneity, they cannot mitigate it, so the risk is invisible and unaddressed. The study directly tests a necessary condition for the risk to persist unchecked.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prolific/MTurk experiment design is well-documented and accessible. CS students can set up paired comparison studies with standard tools. Medium compute suffices for generating model outputs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: generate output pairs, run human ratings, compute discrimination accuracy. Clear metrics and a single well-defined experiment completable in 30 hours with pre-generated outputs.

title: Taxonomy of GenAI Pilot Failure Modes: Where Does Homogeneity Appear?

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: 200 queries, 10+ models, compute similarity and error correlation. Well-scoped replication study completable in 30 hours with existing benchmarks.

title: Homogeneity Replication on Newer Model Generations

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: one stratification variable applied to existing methodology. Binary split (open vs. proprietary), compute within/between similarity. Minimal design decisions needed. Highly completable in 30 hours.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: construct prompt set, run through models, compute similarity. The prompt construction is the main effort; analysis pipeline is reusable from prior work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: 1000 prompts through 15 models, map refusal boundaries, compute overlap. Clear success criteria and a well-defined output. Achievable in 30 hours with pre-existing prompt sets.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: fixed question set with known answers, elicit confidence from models, compute inter-model calibration correlation. Well-defined experiment achievable in 30 hours.
